result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior blockers SV-01, SV-02, and SV-03 plus directly touched SQLite runtime, lhx inspection, snapshot/export smoke, and E2E gate surfaces. Quick-fix 002 resolves the duplicate attach/import and lhx SQLite inspection blockers, but required coverage remains incomplete and the configured npm run verify-all gate is red.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: SqliteThreadStore now scans existing thread.sqlite files before consulting index.json in createThread and findThreadByTarget (src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:817-828, 1031-1048, 1693-1768). The regression test deletes index.json and threadId-map.json before a second attach and asserts TARGET_ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT with the original thread id (tests/context-steward/attach-import-sqlite.test.ts:102-151). Focused SQLite tests passed.

lhx loading now recognizes thread.sqlite, resolves SQLite-only thread directories, and reads thread_json, turn_json, chunk_json, and message_json directly via better-sqlite3 (packages/lh-context/src/core/io.ts:46-70, 86-133, 164-188). JSON error output is structured for LhxError when --json is requested (packages/lh-context/src/commands/run.ts:22-38). The new lhx SQLite smoke test passed and asserts inspect summary returns thread id, message total, and turn total for SQLite-backed state (tests/context-steward/lhx-sqlite-smoke.test.ts:40-76).

Quick-fix 002 added runtime-reopen-sqlite.test.ts, lhx-sqlite-smoke.test.ts, and snapshot-sqlite-smoke.test.ts, and focused Story 2 tests passed. However, the story/test plan still require TC-3.3a, TC-3.3b, TC-3.4a, TC-3.4b, TC-3.5c, and full TC-3.6b coverage, including sqlite-maintenance-row-level.test.ts and runtime-capture failure/retry proof (story lines 138-143; test-plan lines 122-136). rg finds no sqlite-maintenance-row-level test, and the current SQLite capture/import focused tests only match TURN_STATE_INCOMPLETE among the required failure/maintenance/partial-import terms.

newFindings.title: Configured verify-all gate fails on the SQLite-cutover long-thread real PI E2E path
newFindings.evidence: npm run verify-all failed during test:e2e after the service suite passed 533/533. The failing test is tests/context-steward/long-thread-real-pi-execution.e2e.test.ts, which quick-fix 002 changed from FileThreadStore to importFileBackedThread plus SqliteThreadStore (diff shows the store migration at lines around 523, 629, and 794). The failure was in assertOpenAIInputTokenCountingObserved: line 313 expects turn.rawTokenCountMetadata.source to equal provider_input_count, but the gate observed actual pi_heuristic. This is the configured story/epic gate and therefore blocks pass.

openFindings.title: Required SQLite cutover coverage and test classification remain incomplete for several Chunk 2 behaviors
openFindings.evidence: The story requires explicit Chunk 2 mapping for runtime capture failures/retries, stale derived maintenance conflict behavior, generated rollout reconciliation, and lossy/partial import reporting (02-whole-store-runtime-compatibility-cutover.md:138-143; test-plan.md:122-136), plus test classification before close (02-whole-store-runtime-compatibility-cutover.md:177-183, 205-210). Current SQLite-focused files exist for runtime capture, runtime reopen, attach/import, lhx, and snapshot smoke, but rg --files finds no sqlite-maintenance-row-level.test.ts, and rg over runtime-capture-sqlite.test.ts/runtime-reopen-sqlite.test.ts/attach-import-sqlite.test.ts finds only TURN_STATE_INCOMPLETE coverage for failure terms. runtime-capture-sqlite.test.ts covers default prompt/response capture, duplicate idempotency, and turn_end reopen (lines 53-177), but not failed canonical write reporting or transient busy/conflict retry policy. attach-import-sqlite.test.ts covers happy path and duplicate target conflict (lines 50-151), but not unsupported/lossy/partially ordered PI records.
